basics.name: Shreyash Thorat
basics.label: Robotics Engineer — Motion Planning, Control & Simulation
basics.summary: M.S. Mechanical Engineering student at USC working at the intersection of motion planning, model-based control, and physics simulation. I build the full stack — localization, planning, and control code in ROS 2, validated in MuJoCo and Gazebo, running on hardware I designed in SolidWorks and tested to failure. Currently researching in-space manipulation at USC's LASER lab, implementing a manipulator on a microgravity air-bearing free-flyer.

work.name: Laboratory for Autonomous Systems in Exploration and Robotics (LASER), USC
work.summary: Implementing a manipulator on a microgravity free-flyer air-bearing robot. Developing the experimental setup and optimized gripper designs to characterize grasping strategies, and to autonomously identify optimal grasp candidates for in-space manipulation.

work.name: Space Engineering Research Center, USC Information Sciences Institute
work.summary: Collaborated with the hardware and propulsion teams on the Leapfrog lunar lander prototype — a thrust-controlled vehicle used to study powered descent and landing. Analyzed test results and proposed design iterations to improve landing stability.

work.name: GreenDzine Technologies Pvt Ltd
work.summary: Engineered and prototyped mechanical components for electric intralogistics vehicles deployed in warehouses of 100,000+ sq. ft. Applied DFMA principles to improve manufacturability and cut assembly time, and supported the production pipeline from prototype through assembly and testing.

publications.name: Design and Development of a Model Rocket with Recovery System and Thrust Vectoring for Enhanced Performance and Stability
publications.summary: Thrust-vectored model rocket with an integrated servo-actuated recovery system, covering the control architecture, ground and static test campaign, and stability results.

projects.name: UR20 Washing Machine Assembly Cell (MuJoCo + ROS 2)
projects.summary: A full ROS 2 Humble simulation of a UR20 manipulator performing top-load washing machine assembly, with physics in MuJoCo 3.x through the mujoco_ros2_control plugin. Implemented DH forward kinematics, a geometric Jacobian with live manipulability reporting, and a damped least-squares IK solver converging to sub-millimeter position error. Fully containerized for reproducibility.

projects.name: Autonomous Mobile Robot: Localization, Planning & Control
projects.summary: Implemented a particle filter localizer on a known 2D map using LIDAR scan matching and low-variance resampling, achieving pose convergence within a few exploratory motions in Gazebo and RViz. Built an RRT motion planner with obstacle-padded collision checking, shortcut smoothing, waypoint densification, and a reactive safety layer monitoring forward LIDAR returns. Deployed a dual-axis PID controller for heading and velocity regulation inside a closed sense-plan-act loop that corrected odometry drift in real time.

projects.name: 5-DOF Package Handling Robotic Arm
projects.summary: Designed a 5-DOF manipulator with 700 mm reach and 3 kg payload for end-of-line pick and place. Performed inverse kinematics to define the reachable workspace and avoid singularities, sized actuators from joint torque and power budgets, and built a ROS 2 + MoveIt control stack validated in Gazebo.

projects.name: Model Rocket with Active Thrust Vector Control
projects.summary: Led development of a model rocket using servo-gimballed thrust vectoring with gyroscope feedback for flight stability, plus a servo-actuated parachute recovery system. Ground and static tests measured 384 N peak thrust and 320 N·s total impulse while validating TVC response and recovery reliability.

projects.name: Real-Time Surveillance Quadcopter for Flood Rescue
projects.summary: Led a quadcopter project for aerial surveillance in flood rescue. Implemented model predictive control over a 6-DOF dynamic model in MATLAB to minimize state error and control effort, and simulated power draw, ESC efficiency, and battery performance to extend endurance.

projects.name: Classification of Pressure Vessels using CNNs
projects.summary: Built an image dataset of industrial pressure vessels and trained a convolutional classifier to distinguish horizontal, vertical, and spherical geometries for automated inspection.

volunteer.organization: Orion Racing India — Formula Student Team
volunteer.summary: Led a 12-member subsystem team for an electric Formula Student prototype through design reviews, sprint planning, and cross-department integration. Correlated data acquisition logs from track testing against the theoretical vehicle model to tune the system for driver performance. Also led the Cost and Manufacturing event, owning cost analysis, process planning, and design-for-manufacture decisions.
